name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2026-04-30, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.06 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
